name: QuoteFold Request a Quote for WooCommerce
author: Abdul Wahab Taqi

sections.description:
QuoteFold for WooCommerce adds a simple quote request flow to WooCommerce stores.

Customers can add products to a quote list, review the request page, enter their contact details, and submit the quote request without creating an account. The store admin receives an email notification, the customer receives a confirmation email, and the request is saved in the WordPress admin.

Features

  • Add to Quote button for product and archive pages.
  • Quote request page with product table and customer form.
  • Guest quote submissions.
  • Quote request database storage.
  • Basic admin quote list and detail screen.
  • Admin notification email.
  • Customer confirmation email.
  • Basic settings for page, labels, button color, and notification email.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quotefold-request-a-quote-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate QuoteFold for WooCommerce from the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Use the auto-created Request a Quote page or place [quotekit_quote_list] on your own page.

1.0.32

  • Improve database table creation compatibility with older supported MySQL versions.

1.0.31

  • Avoid loading translations from default settings before WordPress initialization.

1.0.30

  • Prevent duplicate bootstrap loading during migration from the previous plugin folder slug.

1.0.29

  • Align WordPress.org metadata, contributor account, WooCommerce dependency, product URL, and text domain with the submitted plugin permalink.

1.0.28

  • Update the plugin website and Premium link to the QuoteFold product URL.

1.0.27

  • Clarify the separate Pro plugin offering and remove unsupported promotional claims.
  • Rename the plugin to QuoteFold Request a Quote for WooCommerce with the quotefold-request-a-quote-for-woocommerce slug and text domain.
  • Preserve existing quote records, settings, shortcodes, sessions, and integration hooks.
  • Use the matching QuoteFold Pro release when replacing the previous QuoteKit plugin.

1.0.26

  • Validate public product access and variation ownership when adding and reading quote items.
  • Replace automatic page rewrites with an explicit, permission-checked Repair Page action.
  • Save list quantities in one request, preserve Pro offer hooks, and display update errors without losing edits.

1.0.11

  • Fixed WordPress.org Plugin Check findings for i18n comments, escaping, readme metadata, language directory, nonce scan notes, and custom quote table queries.

1.0.10

  • Fixed settings saving across General Options, Customization, and Request Quote Page tabs.

1.0.9

  • Reset Defaults now restores only the active settings tab.
  • Improved customization color saving for button color fields.

1.0.2

  • Fixed tabbed settings persistence and added split-layout product cards.

1.0.1

  • Improved settings UI controls, quote page repair, and storefront button behavior.

1.0.0

  • Initial standalone free plugin extraction.
